case explicit/mixed
inputs
  options discard-ignored=false discard-branch=false full=false
  recorded <set-retained-removable:id> <set-retained-removable:path> remove <digest:target:<set-retained-removable:id>>
  recorded <set-retained-residue:id> <set-retained-residue:path> retain <digest:target:<set-retained-residue:id>>
commits
  commit <tip:<set-retained-removable:branch>> tree:6b24ff4d7c27 parents=(tree:5f905c2f921d)
  commit <tip:<set-retained-residue:branch>> tree:a7593bf5901f parents=(tree:6b24ff4d7c27)
  commit <tip:refs/heads/main> tree:a7593bf5901f parents=(tree:6b24ff4d7c27)
refs-before
  ref <tip:<set-retained-removable:branch>> <set-retained-removable:branch>
  ref <tip:<set-retained-residue:branch>> <set-retained-residue:branch>
  ref <tip:refs/heads/main> refs/heads/main
response
  error none
  stale false
  rows 2 nil=false order=prefix 2 of 2
  row <set-retained-removable:path> | removed | clean | count=0 bytes=0 shown=0 truncated=false | none | <digest:target:<set-retained-removable:id>> |  | reason-code= | assignment=
  row <set-retained-residue:path> | retain | clean | count=1 bytes=8 shown=1 truncated=false | none | <digest:plan> | ignored residuals require --discard-ignored | reason-code=ignored | assignment=<set-retained-residue:id>
after
  member set-retained-removable tree=absent ledger=absent
  member set-retained-residue tree=present ledger=active
  receipt op=worktree-clean target=<set-retained-removable:path> state=complete phase=terminal action=removed recovery=none fingerprint=<digest:target:<set-retained-removable:id>> checkpoint=<digest:target:<set-retained-removable:id>> branch=<set-retained-removable:branch> branch-oid=<tip:<set-retained-removable:branch>> assignment=<set-retained-removable:id> owner=<set-retained-removable:owner> owned=true repo=<root>/.git detail=""
  ref <tip:<set-retained-residue:branch>> <set-retained-residue:branch>
  ref <tip:refs/heads/main> refs/heads/main
